label: Mistral Vibe Access
description: A Mistral login, for the MistralVibe nodes' `access`: a Mistral API key. One access for however many MistralVibe nodes.

steps: Sign in at chat.mistral.ai (a free account works), open Code, then Vibe CLI, and create a key there.
Paste it below and name the connection. Turns use that account's plan: its free mode, a paid plan or pay-as-you-go.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the MistralVibe nodes' `access` input.
